question: If the diameter of a hemisphere is 84 cm, then what is the volume of hemisphere?
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of the hemisphere = 84 cm

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = Diameter / 2 = 84 / 2 = 42 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a hemisphere = (2)/(3) pi r³

**Calculation:**

Volume of the hemisphere

⇒ (2)/(3) pi 42³

⇒ (2/3) × (22/7) × 42 × 42 × 42

⇒ (2/3) × (22/7) × 74088

⇒ (2/3) × 235872

⇒ 2 × 33696

⇒ 155232 cm³

**The volume of the hemisphere is 155232 cm³.**
